purpose: Exact local retrieval packages for the MORE acceptance path and EAT grounded-fallback path.

usage.en: Use during a familiar routine when a child asks for another portion, turn or repetition.

routine_guidance.en: Use the sign naturally just before offering more food.
routine_guidance.es: Haz el signo de forma natural justo antes de ofrecer más comida.
